seo_and_accessibility_risks.issue: Every visible project image has an empty alt attribute, and each lightbox link has no anchor text or accessible name.
Portfolio project titles do not link to dedicated project pages; destinations are direct original JPEG assets, limiting crawlable project context and internal-link value.
The source contains two H1 elements; the second is a generic CTA heading.
Heading hierarchy jumps from H3 to H1, then H4 and H6; the footer description is incorrectly marked up as H6.
All portfolio filters use href="#" and require JavaScript; they are controls rather than real category/archive URLs.
Open Graph description/image and Twitter title/description/image are absent.
One visible Contactez-nous CTA has an empty href, and header/footer phone and email anchors also have empty href values.
The viewport disables user scaling with user-scalable=0, an accessibility risk.
The page has only one short introductory paragraph and no dedicated textual project descriptions.
Schema is generic WebPage/BreadcrumbList/WebSite/Organization only; portfolio projects have no CreativeWork/Project-level structured representation.
